role.roleTitle: Technical Program Manager, Identity Provider Service

evidence.text: Ran the staged production rollouts of thirty-four identity provider changes across the five regions between 2022 and 2025, from the first canary region to full coverage, each on a rollout ticket in my name.
Ran the launch readiness review before each rollout and held the rollout schedule for the identity service, with the review minutes and the schedule in the identity launch folder.

Watched each rollout with identity SRE from the launch channel and halted four rollouts and rolled back one when the sign-in error rate moved outside the agreed band; the five events are recorded on their rollout tickets.
Planned each change's rollout stages and the region order with the engineering teams in the rollout planning session, recording the plan on the rollout ticket before the readiness review.
Wrote the launch record for each change, listing the residual risks, the regions where the change stayed behind a flag and the hand-over conditions for the regional operations leads.
